svg.title: Agentic support assistant — detailed data flow
svg.desc: Salesforce events flow through an ingestion API and redaction checkpoint, Event Hubs, extraction, promotion and human review to approved memory. An indexer commits PostgreSQL before embedding into FAISS. User queries fan out into filtered lexical and vector recall, merge through RRF, then pass through generation and output guards. Salesforce writes require human approval. Dashed lines show control and failure paths.
svg.text: Concept proposal — not implemented or deployed · an idea for enterprise support teams
Docker · KEDA scales extraction workers on consumer lag
Retry failed publishes; deduplicate by event ID.
Confirm source replay guarantees before rollout.
Read from right to left: commit record → re-scan PII → generate embedding → publish index version. PII tokens resolve only in the authorized agent UI.
03 QUERY / RETRIEVAL + AGENT / AZURE CONTAINER APPS
Same Azure OpenAI service · separate embedding and chat deployments
Both recall legs apply tenant + ACL + approved-status + product-version filters. No result above threshold → escalate. Query vectors use the same embedding deployment.
Agent UI → human approval → allowlisted MCP → Salesforce.
Salesforce changes re-enter the ingestion path via CDC/events.
Controls apply across ingestion, memory and agent services
Consumer lag, DLQ, latency, token cost
